name: 极智MCP
description: 跨平台 MCP 适配网关：一次接入，自动适配分发到豆包、通义、文心、Claude 等主流 Agent 平台，统一鉴权与用量看板；内置不可篡改的跨 Agent 结算账本（账户/原子转账/幂等/哈希链存证）。
description_zh: 把普通 HTTP API 一键托管为标准 MCP 服务，自动适配分发到豆包、通义、文心、Claude 等主流 Agent 平台，统一鉴权、统一用量看板；内置跨 Agent 结算账本，支持多 Agent 任务结算与审计。
description_en: Host any HTTP API as a standard MCP server and auto-distribute it to mainstream Agent platforms (Doubao, Tongyi, Wenxin, Claude). Unified auth and usage dashboard, plus a tamper-evident cross-agent settlement ledger (accounts, atomic transfers, idempotency, hash-chain audit).
examples_zh: 能把我们的天气查询接口做成 MCP 工具吗？让豆包、通义都能直接调用
我们有个自建的 HTTP 接口，想托管成 MCP 服务，API-Key 和调用次数统一管起来
多 Agent 协作时怎么给每个 Agent 计量用量、彼此结算 credits？
今天这个 MCP 服务调了多少次、成功率多少？帮我看看
examples_en: Can we turn our weather query API into an MCP tool so Doubao and Tongyi can call it directly?
We have a custom HTTP API and want to host it as an MCP service with centralized API keys and usage tracking.
How can multiple agents settle credits and audit usage against each other in a multi-agent task?
How many calls did this MCP service handle today, and what was the success rate?
